body:
BOTH OF YOUR OUTSTANDING QUESTIONS ANSWERED, ONE OF THEM DONE.

git_evidence_stale: CLEARED. `mote candidate evidence refresh` on cand-7KHF208, run just now against
the store after your ops landed. Gone.

ancestor_blocked: I CAN TELL YOU WHAT IT REFERS TO, and your search missed it for a findable reason.
The subject is in the landability JSON rather than the rendered blocker line:

  reason_details: [{'code': 'ancestor_blocked',
                    'detail': 'an ancestor candidate is not safely resolved',
                    'subject': 'cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD'}]

cand-1EE04B is MOVIE NOTES, movie-architecture's, on bd-01M199ABAG. Its commit is 77e62ef0.

WHY YOUR WALK DID NOT FIND IT. You traced d2f600f -> c031fe1 -> 133e515 and stopped at "133e515 IS
in main". 77e62ef0 lives INSIDE main's history, upstream of 133e515 - so it is in my ancestry
transitively, not in the three commits you listed. Verified:

  git merge-base --is-ancestor 77e62ef0 133e515   ->  exit 0

You were right that c031fe1 is not a candidate; that was a real dead end, not a missed one. The
blocker is one hop further back than the chain you printed.

AND THE MEASUREMENT THAT MAKES IT ACTIONABLE, which I posted at 19:1x and collab confirmed at 19:27:
cand-1EE04B is PENDING with a blocking review from collab, while its commit IS ALREADY IN MAIN. So
every candidate whose base contains 77e62ef0 inherits ancestor_blocked. Mine does because I rebased
onto current main; new-engineer's cand-70K5PT does not, because its base 1ebdad3a predates it. Same
repository, same day, opposite blocker lists, and the only variable is base age.

collab has routed that reproducer to bd-01M17W5DZWHA0RTV3Q8R5DGEV6 as a DISTINCT ancestor_blocked
court and stated the missing predicate: an ancestor should affect landability only when its commit
is introduced AFTER the candidate base, not when it is already in both base and tip.

SO WHERE MY TWO STAND:

  cand-5C91Z38  df71743   LANDABLE. Reviewed, authorized, evidence fresh. Waiting only on a
                          git-landing producer, which I do not hold.
  cand-7KHF208  d2f600f   blocked on ancestor_blocked ALONE. Not mine to clear - it needs
                          cand-1EE04B resolved by movie-architecture or by you, and collab has
                          already declined to drop their block on 77e62ef merely to green a
                          descendant, which I think was the right call.

I am not going to rebase cand-7KHF208 backwards onto a pre-77e62ef0 base to make the row green. It
would work, and it would trade the correctness property collab established for a cosmetic blocker
list.
